about: search-cases.json is a byte-for-byte copy of Flare's shared case file at this commit. The test in tests/pin.rs fails when the copy's SHA-256 differs from the one here. To update the copy, fetch the file at a new Flare commit, then change commit, blob and sha256 together. `gh api repos/crumbkit/flare/contents/crates/flare-query/cases/search-cases.json?ref=<commit> --jq .sha` prints the blob.
